test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: While selling to the retailer, a company allows 30% discount on the marked price of its products. If the retailer sells those products at marked price, his profit per cent will be ________.
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Discount = 30% 

**FORMULA USED:**

Profit = (S.P. - C.P.)

Where S.P. = Selling price, C.P. = Cost price

Profit% = (Profit/C.P.) × 100 

**CALCULATION:**

Let the Marked price be Rs100.

30% Discount on marked price =( 30/100 )× 100 = Rs30.

Hence, Discount = Rs30.

Now, C.P. of retailer = S.P of company = ( M.P. - Discount )

⇒ (100 - 30) = Rs 70.

Now, According to the given Question ,

S.P. of retailer = M.P. 

Hence, S.P. of retailer = Rs100. and C.P. = Rs70.

Hence, Profit = (S.P.- C.P.) = (100 -70) = Rs30.

⇒ Profit% = (Profit/C.P.) × 100

⇒ ( 30/70) × 100 = (300/7) % = 42 (6)/(7) %.

**∴ Profit% is 42(6)/(7)** %**.**
